settings.label: Which AI do you want to use?
settings.help: Google Gemini is free (a free key from Google, no card). Choose OpenAI if you already pay for ChatGPT's API: a little more reliable at busy hours.

settings.label: Business name
settings.help: As your customers know it. Example: Ranime Jemal Agency

settings.label: Your ideal customer
settings.help: Who is a good fit: industry, size, need, budget. Example: Real-estate agencies with 5 to 50 agents that want more qualified buyers.

settings.label: Minimum fit score (0 to 100)
settings.help: Leads scoring at least this are sent to a salesperson. 60 is a good start.

settings.label: Who gets which leads
settings.help: One rule per line: a keyword, then = and the salesperson's email. Example: real estate = alice@yourbusiness.com. Leave empty to send every qualified lead to the default salesperson.

settings.label: Default salesperson email
settings.help: Qualified leads that match no routing rule are sent here.

settings.label: Sender name on emails
settings.help: The name people see in their inbox. Example: Sarah from Maison Lina

settings.label: Google Sheet link
settings.help: Create an empty Google Sheet, add the tabs from the guide, then copy the link from your browser's address bar and paste it here.
